$description: Golden vector for the EVM-form Order of a Canton-source intent (tech plan §3.2a). A Canton intent has no EVM user and no EVM input token, so both are deterministic labels derived from the Canton identifiers, and the source EIP-712 domain points at a fixed anchor address instead of a deployed router. Nothing on chain checks this construction: it is the only rule that makes a Canton delivery matchable on an EVM destination, and every implementation (Solidity tests, @cancore/contracts, the backend, the attestors, the fillers) must reproduce the orderHash below byte for byte.
$producedBy: test/helpers/cantonOrder.ts — buildCantonSourceOrder(); verified against CancoreRouter.sourceOrderHash in test/CancoreRouter.ts

constants.$eip2294MaxChainId: floor((2^64 - 1) / 2) - 36. Every Canton origin id is above it, so no EVM chain can ever collide with one.
constants.$cantonOriginId: 2^63 + n. Above the EIP-2294 bound, inside uint64 (Order.originChainId), recognisable by eye. 2^63 itself is deliberately unassigned: a bare 9223372036854775808 in a config is more likely a truncation artefact than a deliberate choice.
constants.$cantonSourceAnchor: address(uint160(uint256(keccak256("cancore:canton-source-anchor:v1")))) — the verifyingContract of the Canton source domain. One value for every Canton network: the domain already separates them through chainId. Register it once per origin id with setSourceRouter(originChainId, anchor) on every destination router — that call is WRITE-ONCE.

rules.inputAmount: amount × 10^10 (Daml Numeric 10); the request is refused unless it is exact
rules.minReceived: minReceived × 10^decimals(wantToken); the request is refused unless it is exact
rules.feeBps: feeRate × 10000; refused unless it is a whole number and ≤ MAX_FEE_BPS (1000). The fee is INCLUSIVE on both rails: inputAmount is the total, payout = inputAmount × 10000 / (10000 + feeBps) floored, fee = inputAmount − payout
rules.createdAt: unix seconds, the signing time of the Canton request; refused unless it is a whole second. Part of the hash only: the destination does not check it
rules.fillDeadline: unix seconds; refused unless it is a whole second
rules.$requestId: requestId is part of the owner label on purpose: without it two identical requests in the same second share one orderHash, and one delivery would match two SwapIntents (AUD-E-13, AUD-C-3).
